VR.title: Immersed Says It’s Finally Getting Ready to Ship ‘Visor’ VR Headset
VR.summary: Immersed is set to ship its long-awaited Visor VR headset, focusing on work applications, after confirming shipping timelines to pre-order customers.

VR.title: Mixed Reality Tower Defense Game Cybercore Protocol Out Now In Early Access On Quest
VR.summary: Cybercore Protocol, a mixed reality tower defense game, has launched in Early Access on Quest, inviting players to experience its unique gameplay.

VR.title: Quest's Horizon+ Subscription Added 10 Monthly Hours Of Xbox Games
VR.summary: Meta's Horizon+ subscription now offers 10 hours of Xbox cloud gaming each month, enhancing its appeal to Quest users.

VR.summary: Roboquest VR has launched on Meta Quest 3, featuring a co-op mode that supports cross-play across multiple VR platforms.

VR.summary: A.R. Rahman has launched ARR Immersive for Apple Vision Pro, offering original immersive music experiences in 360 and 180-degree formats.

VR.title: Futuristic VR FPS Hyper Dash Shutting Down This November
VR.summary: Triangle Factory will shut down its futuristic FPS Hyper Dash this November, marking the end of its service.

AI.summary: Anthropic has released its latest AI model, Claude Opus 5, claiming it approaches the capabilities of its predecessor, Claude Fable 5.

AI.title: Microsoft unveils AI security tools it says outperform competing platforms
AI.summary: Microsoft has unveiled new AI security tools, claiming they outperform competitors while being more cost-effective.

AI.title: Why China is giving away its best AI models

NFL.title: Vikings announce signings of running back Jordan Mims, linebacker Jamal Adams
NFL.summary: The Vikings have signed running back Jordan Mims and linebacker Jamal Adams as veterans report to training camp.
